dedupe_keys.name: seismic performance of an industrial multi storey frame structure with process equipment shake table tests eucentre

description: This dataset holds the results of full-scale shake table tests on a three-storey steel moment-resisting frame fitted with typical industrial process equipment. The BED Experiments page says the frame, about 4 m by 4 m by 9.3 m with flexible diaphragms, carried vertical and horizontal steel tanks connected by steel piping, an electrical cabinet and a conveyor, and was tested at the EUCENTRE laboratories in Pavia in 2020 to study the interaction between the frame and the process components and to check floor spectra predictions; it was funded by the Horizon 2020 SERA project. It was published in version 1.0 by seven authors led by C. Butenweg, and DataCite lists one zip of about 0.62 GB with XLS, TXT, MAT, JPG, PPTX and DWG files, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one test specimen. Caveats: it is a laboratory specimen, not a real plant, and the list of ground motions and the instrument layout are not stated on the page read (they are in the 2021 Engineering Structures paper). For simulation it gives measured responses of tanks, piping and frames to calibrate seismic fragility models of process plants and Natech event trees. Related catalogue records include the virtual oil refinery seismic testbed, the NEES critical facility equipment isolation test and the EPFL-EUCENTRE shake table data set.
